role: the source propositional alphabet as a set of atoms
notes: Editorial name for the source set of variables p_n (n in N) of sec:prop-syntax-semantics-01; the source macro is restoration-only. Form(P_N) is the source formula set.

role: formula obtained by renaming each atom q to p_{c(q)} along an atom coding c
notes: Structural recursion; injective when c is injective. Superscript is the coding, not a power or complement.

role: extension of a finite assignment s on A to a valuation on P by value 0 off A
notes: Defined by cases on membership in A; no choice.

role: code number of a propositional formula: number with binary numeral 1 followed by the def:p02-sat-taut encoding
notes: Same glyph and the same 'fixed effective code' role family as the P5 Goedel-number row; different coding and scope.

role: uniformly decidable premise family whose satisfiability is undecidable
notes: theta_y = not p_0 and (p_{y+1} or not p_{y+1}); Gamma_x = {p_0} with theta_y for witnesses y of x in K.

role: padded witness formula of the premise family \(\Gamma_x\)
notes: theta_y = not p_0 and (p_{y+1} or not p_{y+1}); Gamma_x = {p_0} with theta_y for witnesses y of x in K.

role: decidable satisfiable premise set without computable model
notes: tau_y is the tautology instance on p_{2y+1}; delta_{x,y} carries the sign of p_{2x} fixed by U(y).

role: member of the premise set \(\Delta\) carrying the sign of \(p_{2x}\)
notes: tau_y is the tautology instance on p_{2y+1}; delta_{x,y} carries the sign of p_{2x} fixed by U(y).

role: tautology instance on \(p_{2y+1}\) padding the members of \(\Delta\)
notes: tau_y is the tautology instance on p_{2y+1}; delta_{x,y} carries the sign of p_{2x} fixed by U(y).

role: local computable or partial computable functions and decidable relations in the annex constructions
notes: F(x) = varphi_x(x); T(x,y) = T_1(e*,x,y) from the cited normal form; W least-witness relation; B,C,D,M bounded-search functions; t,d code-number maps. Local to the annex section; F is not the filter F of sec:p02-free-boolean-completeness.

role: cutoff subtraction predecessor zero-test and equality-test primitive recursive functions
notes: Numerical functions; the dotted minus has the P12 cutoff-subtraction meaning, not the P8 Brouwerian difference.

role: pair-selection premises for a family of disjoint pairs and the valuation/choice-function correspondence
notes: A_a is the member of the family containing a.

role: translation from the P1 compactness language with top into Form(P) and the induced valuation
notes: top goes to not-bottom; v_nu(p_v) = nu(v).
